headline: A 2019 federal law renames a Postal Service building in Sun Prairie, Wisconsin, after fire captain Cory Barr.
what_it_does: The law officially names the United States Postal Service facility at 1715 Linnerud Drive in Sun Prairie, Wisconsin, the "Fire Captain Cory Barr Post Office Building." It changes only the name used for the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or how the building operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 31, 2019, and the name took effect when it was signed.
